query: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "total_ads!", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.is_automatic, false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS "auto_ads!", AVG(a.duration_seconds)::float8 AS avg_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT a.session_id)::bigint AS "sessions_with_ads!" FROM twitch_ad_break_events a LEFT JOIN twitch_stream_sessions s ON s.id = a.session_id WHERE a.started_at >= $1 AND ($2 = '' OR LOWER(s.streamer_login) = $2)
